stream_lifetime_seconds.title: Stream Lifetime Seconds

RelayPolicy.description: Applied by every node of the cluster from the release that carries it.

actor_id.title: Actor Id
actor_id.description: Platform administrator who requested it, if any

initiator.description: operator: requested through the release endpoint; auto_publisher: published by the worker after a source change

rollback_revision.title: Rollback Revision
rollback_revision.description: Historical revision whose resources this release republished

site_name.description: Shown in the console and in identity mail

site_name.description: Shown in the console and in identity mail

handle.description: The ID Relay returns to the key holder; null when no handle was saved
